record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly increase hidden width from 64 to 96 and reduce learning rate from 1e-3 to 8e-4. Extra capacity may improve item discrimination, while smaller updates stabilize the wider network with normalized tied embeddings. Retain two blocks, two heads, 2× feed-forward expansion, dropout 0.2 and all other settings. Preserve masked-target training, appended-mask inference and one checkpoint per category; synchronize checkpoint metadata and predictor dimensions.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, increase hidden width from 64 to 96 and reduce learning rate from 1e-3 to 8e-4. Greater capacity may improve item discrimination, while smaller updates stabilize the wider network. Retain two blocks, two heads, 2× feed-forward expansion and dropout 0.2. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor construction propagate the new width consistently; masked-target training, appended-mask inference and one model per category remain unchanged.
